To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

EIMD/DOS induced by exhaustive exercise was not in protein metabolism specific homeo-stasis(PmSH) and was delayed in the recovery,while EIMD/DOD induced by non exhaustive exercise was in protein metabolism specific homoeostasis(PmHS) and was recovered normally.
the process of EIMD induced by non exhaustive exercise was at PmSh, and EIMD induced in this manner recovered normally.
the process of EIMD induced by exhaustive exercise affects the normal exertion but preventive measures are mostly ineffective,and that the recovery of EMD/DOMS induced is delayed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the homeostasis in skeletal muscle protein metabolism and the homeostasis is closely related to the exertion of sports perform-ance.

EIMD/DONMS induced by non exhaustive exercises and EIMD/DONS induced by exhaustive exercises, and the former was a normal phenomenon and the latter was a pathologic process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
EIMD/DOS was a kind of functional specific homeostasis disorder of skeletal muscle protein metabolism.
EIMD/DOS was a process of the homeostasis in skeletal muscle protein metabolism,and the homeostasis was a dynamic balance between the protein degradation and the protein synthesis.
EIMD/DOSM was the result of a disturbance of PmSH,and the recovery of EISD/DOMS depended on the degree of disturbance of PmSh.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EIMD/D-OMS induced by exhausting exercise was not a homeostatic process but a pathological process,while EIMD/ DOMS induced by nonexhausting exercise was a homeostatic response to the damage.
EIMD/DOSM was a kind of function-specific homeostasis disorder of protein metabolism,and the intervention of exo-genous factors could promote the normal recovery of EIM-D/DOMS.
the homeostasis was the key point of the process of EIMD/ DOMS,and the process of EIDM/DOMS was a process of homeostasis.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the process of EIMD/ DOMS is a dynamic and complicated process of the interaction between exercise-induced muscle damage and protein metabolic homeostasis,so we should pay more attention to the regulation of protein metabolism in the recovery of EMD/DOMS.
the homeostasis in skeletal muscles is not the same for all types of exercise,and that the homeostatic response to different exercise is a key factor in EIMD and DOMS.
EIMD/D-OMS induced by different exercise intensity and exercise time has a different mechanism of homeostasis.
